messages.subject: Re: Hierarchical species tag problem
parts:
Hi Nicolás,
the tag problem should be solved easily. In digiKam, go to the captions / tag menu on the right. Open the tag manager and move the tags to the Species tag group. Then highlight all image thumbnails, click More in the bottom right (in the tags menu) and click "Write metadata to each file". The metadata tags will be updated and the tags will be in the "Species" group.

Besides, there may be issues with the special character in the file path: ñ. If possible try to fix it.

The warning you get is weird and unexpected. I can't make sense of it. Did you get a normal record table so far?
